access_policy.search_contamination_policy: fresh/protected labels and evaluator internals remain outside candidate custody; access telemetry required

exclusion_policy: All candidate revisions, including null/harmful/rejected variants, remain append-only. Later-stage known harm cannot be hidden by missing earlier evidence. Protected CANNOT_CHECK is retained.
plots: P5V2-1 replay vs fresh transfer acceptance scatter
P5V2-2 harmful acceptance and protected improvement frontier

primary_hypothesis.text: At matched candidate-generation and evaluation resources, the non-compensatory STATIC→REPLAY→FRESH→PROTECTED gate reduces harmful fresh-transfer acceptances by at least 3 percentage points versus the P5 V1 acceptance path while protected fresh-task improvement is non-inferior within 2 percentage points.

resource_policy: V1, V2 and baselines receive the same candidate-generation budget and the same total protected evaluation budget; stage ordering changes evidence admissibility, not the amount of hidden truth available.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Known later-stage harm dominates missing earlier-stage evidence and prevents laundering through IN_PROGRESS.
Retained negative history reduces recurrence of previously recognized harmful candidate classes.
Protected CANNOT_CHECK prevents false promotion recommendations without candidate self-certification.

statistics.interval: 95% paired bootstrap difference plus Wilson intervals for acceptance rates; worst-family tail reported separately
